method: Independent model linguistic review of all 500 roots, every supplied Spanish source row and sense, in batches of 100, followed by a construction/homograph/qualifier pass. English frames and adjective glosses are original model translations of selected Spanish Wiktionary meanings from the pinned CC-BY-SA Spanish snapshot; no retained English-dictionary attribution, source quotation, invented example or native-human certification is claimed. Exact row hash and zero-based senseIndex identify each source anchor. Mandatory pronominal constructions, unclear technical references and unsupported subject profiles are withheld. Frames avoid unfilled internal object slots; generic lexical arguments expressly named by the source are not assertions of actual participants. Qualifiers are preserved in concise context/notes. No irregular English overrides are supplied, and existing grammar/subject/aspect/inflection gates remain mandatory. Lexical approvals are not rendered-word coverage and do not use RLA rule inference.
